description: Stroke a graph (polylines / Skeleton branches) into a ribbon of a set width — sharp, curved, or rectangular (boxed) joints. Clip to boundary trims ends to the source space; Union merges the segments into a single Space; Get Outer Boundary returns the single space bounded by the joined ribbon's outer edge.
instructions:
Strokes an incoming GRAPH (polylines — e.g. Skeleton in Branches mode) into a closed ribbon of `width` metres, mitred at shared endpoints. `join` = Sharp (mitred) / Curved (rounded) / Rectangular (boxed joints). `useSameWidth` off → each segment strokes at its own canvas thickness (the Width slider hides).

`clipToBoundary` trims ends to the source space; `union` fuses the per-segment ribbons into ONE Space; `getOuterBoundary` instead outputs the single Space bounded by the joined ribbon's OUTER edge. The `gin-boundary` input clips to a given Space (else auto-detects the upstream Skeleton's source). One handle per ribbon Space, or a single bundle. Width is wireable.
